newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand to release 11 detained Cambodian sailors.
newsitem.headline: Thailand to release 11 detained Cambodian sailors.

text.p: The Thai government approved on Tuesday a foreign ministry proposal to release 11 Cambodian sailors detained in Thai jails since last year.
The cabinet of Prime Minister Chavalit Yongchaiyudh had approved the proposal to help improve relations between the two countries, government spokesman, Varathep Rattankorn, said.
The Cambodian sailors were arrested in September last year on piracy charges and intrusion into Thai territorial waters.

They are now in detention, awaiting trial, in eastern Trad province which borders the Cambodian town of Koh Kong. "They will be released once the attorney general withdraws the charges against them," Varathep said, adding he could not give the exact date of their release.
Thailand is often involved in territorial water disputes with Vietnam, Cambodia and Malaysia.
